calculation.description: Ranks assets by trailing 20-session return scaled by trailing 20-session realized volatility; signal at date t uses only data through t and predicts the next five-session cross-sectional return.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 to 2027-10-20 (usable dates begin 2025 due to aligned source availability)
validation.regime_notes: The effective observations are concentrated in 2025-2027 because the 20-day normalized signal and forward horizon require complete aligned histories. The negative IC is consistent across the available recent regime; interpret uncertainty conservatively given the 15-asset universe and 12.03 average cross-section.
